decision: Retain existing canonical AudioOutputLease and CaptureLease as separate admission facts and existing df-audio owners as separate resource lifetimes. Native playback retains whole canonical member/audience/binding/generation/device-unlock lease while canonical capture retains member/binding/generation/permitted-offer/format. Reuse owner-fenced receipts and exact lease equality; never combine capture permission with output access, treat projected output labels as authorization, or move private PCM through another output owner. Application admission/projection/recovery keep existing owners and all pending production gates.
